cases.task: Choose the safe client cursor rule when the same EventSource automatically reconnects after already accepting events and the server sends another ready frame.

required_facts.text: The first ready of a newly constructed EventSource may establish an intentionally rewound manual baseline.
A later ready on the same EventSource follows an automatic reconnect and must not rewind a cursor already advanced by accepted event or page frames.
A malformed or regressive reconnect ready must close the stream, preserve the accepted cursor, and fence queued callbacks.
